merge into t_lhfl_safe_stock a USING (
select #{item.id, jdbcType=DOUBLE} id, #{item.mixArea,jdbcType=VARCHAR} mix_area, #{item.material,jdbcType=VARCHAR} material, #{item.safeStock, jdbcType=DECIMAL} safe_stock, #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} remark, #{item.delFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR} del_flag, #{item.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} create_by, #{item.createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} create_time, #{item.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} update_by, #{item.updateTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} update_time
) b ON ( a.MIX_AREA = b.MIX_AREA and a.material = b.material AND a.del_flag = '0' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE
